svg.title: Fig 6 — Restock hatch latch (spring bolt + servo cam)
svg.desc: Four side sections of the spring-bolt latch on the one-column restock hatch in the top cover: locked/rest, servo unlock, self-latching close and key override, plus a state strip, a top-view inset and a legend.
svg.text: Fig 6 — Restock hatch latch (spring bolt + servo cam)
Side section through the latch edge of the ONE restock hatch in the fixed top cover: outside of the safe is up, inside is down. Same parts in every panel — only positions change.
Smart Med Station · Hardware design v2.1 · 2026-10-07
flat side holds the lid shut
cam can push it one way only
lever held in by the closed lid
MG90S servo S3 + cam lobe r ≈ 12
REST: cam rotated clear of the tab
Spring holds the bolt in the strike · S3 PWM off.
Fail-secure: on power loss the hatch stays locked (the key still works).
bolt tip clear of the strike
→ ! HATCH OPEN → cam back to REST
S3 PWM on only during the window
Host sends UNLOCK → S3 cam retracts the bolt.
Held until ! HATCH OPEN or 5 s timeout → cam returns to REST.
① lid edge pushes the bolt back
snaps the bolt into the strike
bolt slides away from it · no power
Lid edge rides the bevel → bolt snaps into the strike (self-latching).
SAF-2 / CS-7 · works with no power
on the bolt → bolt slides back
the tab moves away from the lobe
Printed key retracts the bolt (SAF-2 / CS-7) · lid opens with no unlock window
→ ! FORCED → host logs OVERRIDE, flagged for review (every key use is logged).
UNLOCK is sent only after the host's restock checks (GOTO j first; CS column: 2FA + witness).
Events: ! HATCH OPEN · ! HATCH CLOSED · ! FORCED (host command: UNLOCK)
S3 is the only latch in v2.
